feeds.title: Reiki Rays
feeds.description: Reiki Rays is your daily source of Reiki inspiration. They publish new, insightful, and informative Reiki articles every day, written by experienced Reiki practitioners and teachers throughout the world. They're dedicated to giving you the best information and tools about Reiki.

feeds.title: Reiki in the Prairie LLC
feeds.description: This blog has a distinctive style that brings you rejuvenation, balance, and knowledge by Cynthia. She is a Reiki Master practitioner. She self-taught herself, with help of some good books, how to read auras, Energy Spirituality, energy cleansing & protection, and how to use her empathic/Clairsentient abilities. She now uses a combination of modern Usui Reiki combined with Japanese Reiki styles.

feeds.title: Mainstream Reiki Blog
feeds.description: Andrea Kennedy, Reiki Master Practitioner and Instructor: Offering Reiki treatment sessions, certification classes and events. Practicing Reiki since 1995. Her mission is to help bring Reiki further into the mainstream of society.

feeds.title: The Energetic Alchemist Blog
feeds.description: Yolanda is a distinguished member of The Reiki Class, an esteemed organization dedicated to promoting ethical and professional standards among Reiki Teachers and Practitioners worldwide. With a deep commitment to holistic healing, she embodies the organization's mission to ensure that seekers receive the highest quality Reiki training and resources available. As part of The Reiki Class, Yolanda engages with a vibrant community of passionate practitioners and educators, all striving to uphold the integrity and effectiveness of Reiki practices.

feeds.title: Parita Shah Healing Blog
feeds.description: Reiki Healer Parita Shah helps clients restore their minds and body through holistic energy healing. Through distant and in-person sessions, as well as events, courses, and a blog, she shares tools for transformation and self-healing. Check out her latest posts on Reiki, mindfulness, meditation, chakra healing, and more.

feeds.title: Harmony Life Reiki Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Marina Lando. I am a Reiki Master and Teacher, Certified Aromatherapist, Published Author, and the founder of Lando Medical Reiki Method. I have been practicing Reiki since 2007. At Harmony Life Reiki, we offer reiki therapy sessions. Check out our blog for all things Reiki, aromatherapy, and energy healing in general!

feeds.title: Arkansas Reiki Institute Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Karen Caig. At Arkansas Reiki Institute, we offer treatment sessions and classes in Holy Fire Reiki through the International Center for Reiki Training. Reiki continues to guide me on my own healing path as I help others find relief for their stress & pain. My mission is to help train at least one Reiki Master for every family so that everyone can heal at a deep level in order to make our world healthier.

feeds.title: Sublime Awakening
feeds.description: ​My name is Olga. I am passionate about Reiki, and my spirituality is an integral part of my life. The Sublime Awakening blog explores Reiki, spirituality, and energy healing, offering insights on intuitive practices, divine energies, and holistic well-being.

feeds.title: Karen Harrison
feeds.description: Karen Harrison's website offers in-depth insights into Reiki practice, training, and spiritual development, featuring topics like Holy Fire® Reiki, Reiki symbols, and the transformative journey of becoming a practitioner.

feeds.title: Reiki with Bronwen
feeds.description: The Reiki with Bronwen blog, curated by Bronwen Logan, offers reflective essays, interviews, and multimedia content on Reiki practice, spiritual growth, and holistic well-being, blending traditional Japanese wisdom with contemporary self-care insights.

feeds.title: Thrive Reiki
feeds.description: ​The Thrive Reiki blog, authored by Andrea Deierlein, provides reflective insights and practical tools on self-care, mindfulness, and energy healing, guiding readers toward inner balance and resilience through the principles of Reiki. ​

feeds.title: Natura Reiki
feeds.description: Explore insightful articles on Reiki, holistic health, and wellness at Natura Reiki. Discover tips on stress relief, self-care practices, and the transformative power of Reiki to help you achieve balance and well-being. Join us on your journey to health and harmony.

feeds.title: Reiki Brigade
feeds.description: Follow our healing adventures as we're out sharing reiki with the world. Share with others to help them understand what reiki is and how it can help them, and the world.

feeds.title: Luminous Heart Reiki & Massage
feeds.description: ​The Luminous Heart Reiki & Massage blog by Pamela Hipp shares personal reflections and practical guidance on holistic healing, self-care, and energy work, aiming to empower readers on their wellness journeys.

feeds.title: Two Bear Healing Arts
feeds.description: An Animal Communication + Reiki session with Susan J. Squittieri uncovers what pets need to feel happy and thrive. Susan also offers classes.

feeds.title: Nalanda Reiki Center
feeds.description: A Blog for Reiki Masters about Reiki Online Articles, Healing & Treatment. It also has details anout Reiki Circles, Reiki Courses, Training & Workshops.

feeds.title: Be Radiant Blog
feeds.description: Deanna understands the complexities of life, and her blog is about encouraging people to look underneath, straight into the heart, and feel what is going on. She provides insights and tips to help and empower you so that you can live more and more in the love that nourishes and upholds your life.

feeds.title: Reiki Therapy Resources Blog
feeds.description: We provide information for practical Reiki applications as well as essential business resources to help you establish and grow your Reiki Therapy business. Our business resources will also help general healing therapists who do not have a Reiki specialty. Visit our blog & keep up with the latest plans, exercises, and tools to help you run your Reiki practice.

feeds.title: Rachael; Teacher Healer Mystic Blog
feeds.description: Rachael's Reiki Healing & Beyond offers services for your whole self through guidance readings, mediumship, Reiki energy healing to Master/Teacher level, teaching others Reiki, Hypnotherapy for Fears, Anxiety, Habit Alteration, and Illness, Past Life Regression, Hopi Ear Candling, and spiritual meditation and development.

feeds.title: Reiki for Life Blog
feeds.description: Learn how to give reiki to yourself and others. Benefit from classes and attunements with others who are seeking to better their lives through Reiki. The Reiki for Life Blog provides vital knowledge on core Reiki concepts and practices. Start your Reiki journey today and change your life for the better!

feeds.title: oSimplicity Energy Healing
feeds.description: oSimplicity Energy Healing by Becky Stiller documents her journey and extensive knowledge of the world of Reiki healing. She enjoys studying and practicing the healing of flower essences and the chakra system. Discover how energy healing blends so beautifully with the emotional and mental health aspects of herbalism.

feeds.title: ReikiScoop
feeds.description: ReikiScoop is where Reiki enthusiasts can find information, inspiration, and hopefully, motivation to improve their practice and live a healthier, more balanced life. Vlad Dimancea founded ReikiScoop to share his passion for this beautiful art-form, and help others get unstuck, learn new techniques, and find their path to a consistent, rewarding Reiki practice.

feeds.title: Insight Services Blog
feeds.description: Susan Grace Wisniewski is an ICRT trained and Certified Holy Fire Usui Reiki Master and Karuna Reiki Master. Susan brings over 20 years of Reiki experience to her Reiki practice, combined with decades of experience with numerous different types of healing modalities. Her Insight Services Blog features weekly articles about Reiki, the Breathe in Light technique, insights & tips for your own self-healing journey, and more.

feeds.title: Human Frequencies Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts about Reiki Science and Research on Energy Medicine and Electromagnetic Biofields. Current situation and presence of Reiki in Hospitals and Clinics around the World.

feeds.title: Reiki For You and Me
feeds.description: Patricia is a certified Traditional Usui and Karuna Reiki Master Teacher as well as a certified Crystal Healer and Intuitive Life (Career) and Grief Coach. She have been in practice now for 11 years. She teaches Reiki classes & give Reiki & Crystal Healing sessions.

feeds.title: Reiki For Your Life Blog
feeds.description: Reiki For Your Life is a relaxing, inspirational and comfortable place for Long Island residents to take Reiki classes as well as experience Reiki healing sessions. Sheryl is a Reiki Master Teacher, Animal Reiki Teacher/Practitioner, Affirmations for Inspiration, firm believer in the powerful body, mind & spirit connection.

feeds.title: Cures by Reiki
feeds.description: M.D. Certified Naturopath and a Reiki Master offering Touch Reiki/ Distance Reiki/ Holistic Healing/ Mental & Emotional Counselling & Naturopathic Recommendations since 2008.

feeds.title: Yoga with Manja
feeds.description: Manja is a Certified Life Enhancement Coach and Master Reiki Practitioner/ Teacher. In her coaching sessions Manja offers energy healing, peace process, yoga nidra and Tibetan meditation, nutritional consultation, hypnotherapy, and EMDR to help her clients become their best self and heal trauma on a physical, emotional, and mental level.

feeds.title: The Reiki Centre Blog
feeds.description: The Reiki Centre specializes in teaching Usui Reiki, an energy therapy originating from Japan in the early 1900s, developed by Mikao Usui. They provide a rich community for learning Reiki to all levels, supporting students throughout their Reiki journey with many community events and gatherings as well as in-depth online support and continual education programs.

feeds.title: Reiki by Rickie Blog
feeds.description: Rickie Freedman is a Reiki Master/Teacher and Physical Therapist. Her focus is the integration of complimentary healing with traditional healthcare. Her specialty is 'Reiki by Rickie - Gentle Touch, Deep Healing'. Rickie brings a positive, joyous, loving attitude and a calming energy to all her work.

feeds.title: Reiki Reverend Blog
feeds.description: Reiki Reverend is dedicated to Spiritual Guidance, Coaching, and, Certification in Energy Healing and Complementary Holistic Therapies. I'm a Holistic Health Practitioner of 8 years, walking this path for the guidance and well-being of others in the Love and Light that exists within us all.

feeds.title: Kukan Reiki Kai
feeds.description: The Kukan Reiki blog offers personal reflections, practical guidance, and spiritual insights on Reiki practice, self-care, and holistic living, blending traditional principles with modern wellness experiences.

feeds.title: Spiritual Awakening Journey
feeds.description: We have tools, tips, and guidance for self-discovery. We are here for you every step of your Spiritual Awakening Journey.

feeds.title: Reiki, Medicine, & Self-Care Blog
feeds.description: Pamela Miles is an international Reiki master practicing since 1986, the foremost Medical Reiki expert, and author of the award-winning book REIKI: A Comprehensive Guide. For 20 years, Pamela has pioneered Reiki practice at academic medical centers such as Harvard, Yale, the NIH, NY Presbyterian-Columbia University etc.

feeds.title: International House of Reiki
feeds.description: The International House of Reiki holds a variety of Events & Courses around the globe with international Reiki and Meditation teachers & authors Frans Stiene & Bronwen Logan (Stiene). We teach Reiki Level I, II, and III courses from the Japanese perspective where the initiation process, course information, and techniques taught stem directly from Japan.

feeds.title: Corie Chu Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Corie Chu. I'm a Reiki Master Teacher, Numerologist, and Intuitive Energy Healer. I am based in Hong Kong and travel around Asia to be of full service, raising consciousness and mindfulness. Read more about my journey and my work in Reiki, Numerology, Intuitive Healing, and Wellness Community Building in my blog.
